# 分析边界

Normal3_1_1 与 Normal3_1_spikein 来自同一 3 号血清的等体积分装，独立完成提取和建库；唯一设计差异是后者在 TRIzol/QIAzol 阶段加入 60 fmol cel-miR-39（序列 TCACCGGGTGTAAATCAGCTTG）。本模块把它们作为一对成对工艺重复，不作为生物学重复或方法 1 的组均值样本。

cel-miR-39 只用于监测外参在提取—建库—测序流程中的观察信号。单点、单序列数据不能换算分子回收比例，也不能支持跨方法的 spike-in 归一化。

```{r helpers, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="prepare", eval=TRUE}
pair_samples <- c(SPIKEIN_CONTROL_SAMPLE, SPIKEIN_SAMPLE)
pair_labels <- c(
  spikein_pair_control = "Control (Normal3_1_1)",
  spikein_pair_test = "Spike-in, 60 fmol (Normal3_1_spikein)"
)
pair_label_levels <- unname(pair_labels[c("spikein_pair_control", "spikein_pair_test")])

# Publication palette: the same semantic color is used in every module-13 panel.
publication_blue <- "#2166AC"
publication_red <- "#B2182B"
publication_shared <- "#4D4D4D"
publication_light_grey <- "#BDBDBD"
pair_color_values <- setNames(c(publication_blue, publication_red), pair_label_levels)

edit_distance <- function(x, y = SPIKEIN_SEQ) as.numeric(adist(x, y))

classify_spikein_variant <- function(sequence) {
  sequence <- as.character(sequence)
  len <- nchar(sequence)
  target_len <- nchar(SPIKEIN_SEQ)
  dist <- edit_distance(sequence)
  if (identical(sequence, SPIKEIN_SEQ)) return("exact")
  if (!is.finite(dist) || dist != 1) return(NA_character_)
  if (len == target_len) return("one_base_substitution")
  if (len == target_len - 1) return("one_base_deletion")
  if (len == target_len + 1) return("one_base_insertion")
  NA_character_
}

classify_detection <- function(control_cpm, spike_cpm, threshold) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    control_cpm >= threshold & spike_cpm >= threshold ~ "shared",
    control_cpm >= threshold & spike_cpm < threshold ~ "control_only",
    control_cpm < threshold & spike_cpm >= threshold ~ "spike_only",
    TRUE ~ "neither"
  )
}

pair_meta <- sample_info %>%
  filter(as.character(Sample) %in% pair_samples) %>%
  transmute(
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    AnalysisRole,
    BiologicalSample = as.character(BiologicalSample),
    Method = as.character(Method)
  )
if (nrow(pair_meta) != 2 || !setequal(pair_meta$Sample, pair_samples)) {
  stop("成对工艺重复必须恰好包含 Normal3_1_1 和 Normal3_1_spikein。")
}

candidate_sequences <- output_all %>%
  filter(Sequence %in% spikein_edit1_sequences(SPIKEIN_SEQ)) %>%
  distinct(Sequence) %>%
  mutate(
    Length = nchar(Sequence),
    EditDistance = vapply(Sequence, edit_distance, numeric(1)),
    VariantClass = vapply(Sequence, classify_spikein_variant, character(1))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(VariantClass)) %>%
  arrange(match(VariantClass, c("exact", "one_base_substitution", "one_base_deletion", "one_base_insertion")), Sequence)

candidate_counts <- output_all %>%
  filter(Sequence %in% candidate_sequences$Sequence) %>%
  left_join(candidate_sequences %>% select(Sequence, EditDistance, VariantClass), by = "Sequence") %>%
  group_by(Sample, Sequence, Length, EditDistance, VariantClass) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

spi_detection <- spikein_counts_by_sample %>%
  transmute(
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    Group = as.character(Group),
    BiologicalSample = as.character(BiologicalSample),
    AnalysisRole = sample_info$AnalysisRole[match(as.character(Sample), as.character(sample_info$Sample))],
    Spikein = Spikein,
    CleanReads,
    SpikeinExactReads,
    SpikeinNearReads,
    SpikeinCandidateReads = SpikeinExactReads + SpikeinNearReads,
    SpikeinExactRPM = SpikeinRPM,
    SpikeinCandidateRPM = if_else(CleanReads > 0, 1e6 * SpikeinCandidateReads / CleanReads, 0),
    ExactDetected = SpikeinExactReads > 0,
    CandidateDetected = SpikeinCandidateReads > 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(Sample, as.character(sample_info$Sample)))
write_csv_safe(spi_detection, "spikein_detection_by_sample.csv")

spike_sample <- spi_detection %>% filter(Sample == SPIKEIN_SAMPLE) %>% slice(1)
negative_samples <- spi_detection %>% filter(!Spikein)
spikein_qc_summary <- tibble(
  SpikeinSample = SPIKEIN_SAMPLE,
  ControlSample = SPIKEIN_CONTROL_SAMPLE,
  SpikeinInputFmol = SPIKEIN_AMOUNT_FMOL,
  CleanReads = spike_sample$CleanReads,
  ExactReads = spike_sample$SpikeinExactReads,
  NearMatchReads = spike_sample$SpikeinNearReads,
  CandidateReads = spike_sample$SpikeinCandidateReads,
  ExactRPM = spike_sample$SpikeinExactRPM,
  CandidateRPM = spike_sample$SpikeinCandidateRPM,
  ExactFractionOfCandidatesPct = if_else(
    spike_sample$SpikeinCandidateReads > 0,
    100 * spike_sample$SpikeinExactReads / spike_sample$SpikeinCandidateReads,
    NA_real_
  ),
  NonSpikeinSampleN = nrow(negative_samples),
  NonSpikeinExactPositiveN = sum(negative_samples$SpikeinExactReads > 0),
  NonSpikeinCandidatePositiveN = sum(negative_samples$SpikeinCandidateReads > 0)
)
write_csv_safe(spikein_qc_summary, "spikein_qc_summary.csv")

variant_tbl <- candidate_counts %>%
  filter(Sample == SPIKEIN_SAMPLE) %>%
  left_join(
    output_all %>% filter(Sample == SPIKEIN_SAMPLE) %>% distinct(Sequence, PrimaryAnnotation, FullAnnotation = Annotation),
    by = "Sequence"
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(VariantClass, c("exact", "one_base_substitution", "one_base_deletion", "one_base_insertion")), desc(Reads), Sequence)
write_csv_safe(variant_tbl, "spikein_sequence_variants.csv")
```

# 1. cel-miR-39 跨库检出

本表同时报告精确序列和编辑距离 1 的同长替换、单碱基插入/缺失近邻。未加外参的 11 个库只用于观察跨库 exact/candidate 信号，不等同于提取空白。

```{r spikein-overview-plot, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
detect_plot_df <- spi_detection %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = factor(Sample, levels = rev(as.character(sample_info$Sample))),
    Role = if_else(Sample == SPIKEIN_SAMPLE, "spike-in library", "no spike-in"),
    Role = factor(Role, levels = c("no spike-in", "spike-in library")),
    LogCandidateReads = log10(SpikeinCandidateReads + 1)
  )

p_detect <- ggplot(detect_plot_df, aes(x = Sample, y = LogCandidateReads, fill = Role)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("no spike-in" = publication_blue, "spike-in library" = publication_red)) +
  labs(
    title = "cel-miR-39 candidate reads across all libraries",
    subtitle = "Bar height: log10(candidate reads + 1); 11 non-spiked libraries screen for cross-library carryover",
    x = NULL, y = "log10(candidate reads + 1)", fill = NULL
  ) +
  serum_theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_variants <- variant_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    VariantLabel = dplyr::case_when(
      VariantClass == "exact" ~ "exact",
      VariantClass == "one_base_substitution" ~ "one-base substitution",
      VariantClass == "one_base_deletion" ~ "one-base deletion",
      VariantClass == "one_base_insertion" ~ "one-base insertion",
      TRUE ~ VariantClass
    ),
    VariantLabel = factor(VariantLabel, levels = c("exact", "one-base substitution", "one-base deletion", "one-base insertion"))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Sequence, Reads), y = Reads, fill = VariantLabel)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      exact = publication_red,
      "one-base substitution" = "#F1A340",
      "one-base deletion" = publication_blue,
      "one-base insertion" = "#762A83"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(title = "Normal3_1_spikein candidate sequence composition", x = "sequence", y = "reads", fill = NULL) +
  serum_theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

save_plot((p_detect / p_variants) + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.3)), "spikein_detection_overview.pdf", width = 11, height = 10)
```

精确 cel-miR-39 只用于特异性检出判断；candidate 总量和变体组成用于 QC 记录，不解释为提取效率或成熟 miRNA 的天然异构体生物学。

# 2. 成对工艺重复的库级 profile

```{r pair-profile-tables, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
candidate_reads_by_sample <- candidate_counts %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  summarise(CandidateReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

candidate_class_reads <- output_all %>%
  filter(Sample %in% pair_samples, Sequence %in% candidate_sequences$Sequence) %>%
  group_by(Sample, MainCategory = FeatureCategory) %>%
  summarise(CandidateClassReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

candidate_length_reads <- candidate_counts %>%
  filter(Sample %in% pair_samples) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Length) %>%
  summarise(CandidateLengthReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

pair_library_qc <- pair_meta %>%
  left_join(clean_reads_tbl %>% mutate(Sample = as.character(Sample)), by = "Sample") %>%
  left_join(match_reads_tbl %>% mutate(Sample = as.character(Sample)), by = "Sample") %>%
  left_join(candidate_reads_by_sample, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    CandidateReads = replace_na(CandidateReads, 0),
    EndogenousCleanReads = CleanReads - CandidateReads,
    GenomeMappingRatePct = 100 * MatchGenome / CleanReads,
    Label = unname(pair_labels[AnalysisRole])
  )
write_csv_safe(pair_library_qc, "paired_library_qc.csv")

paired_class_composition <- sample_comp_view %>%
  filter(as.character(Sample) %in% pair_samples) %>%
  mutate(Sample = as.character(Sample), MainCategory = as.character(MainCategory)) %>%
  left_join(candidate_class_reads, by = c("Sample", "MainCategory")) %>%
  left_join(pair_library_qc %>% select(Sample, EndogenousCleanReads), by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    CandidateClassReads = replace_na(CandidateClassReads, 0),
    ReadsBeforeSpikeinExclusion = Reads,
    Reads = ReadsBeforeSpikeinExclusion - CandidateClassReads,
    Percent = if_else(EndogenousCleanReads > 0, 100 * Reads / EndogenousCleanReads, 0),
    Label = unname(pair_labels[match(Sample, pair_meta$Sample)])
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(Sample, pair_samples), desc(Percent), MainCategory)
if (any(paired_class_composition$Reads < 0)) {
  stop("外参候选序列扣除后出现负的 RNA 类别计数。")
}
write_csv_safe(paired_class_composition, "paired_class_composition.csv")

paired_length_profile <- length_all_raw %>%
  filter(Sample %in% pair_samples, Class == "Clean_Reads") %>%
  group_by(Sample, Length) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(candidate_length_reads, by = c("Sample", "Length")) %>%
  left_join(pair_library_qc %>% select(Sample, EndogenousCleanReads), by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    CandidateLengthReads = replace_na(CandidateLengthReads, 0),
    ReadsBeforeSpikeinExclusion = Reads,
    Reads = ReadsBeforeSpikeinExclusion - CandidateLengthReads,
    Percent = if_else(EndogenousCleanReads > 0, 100 * Reads / EndogenousCleanReads, 0),
    Label = unname(pair_labels[match(Sample, pair_meta$Sample)])
  ) %>%
  arrange(Sample, Length)
if (any(paired_length_profile$Reads < 0)) {
  stop("外参候选序列扣除后出现负的长度计数。")
}
write_csv_safe(paired_length_profile, "paired_length_profile.csv")
```

# 3. CPM 校正后的 annotation / sequence 一致性

```{r paired-abundance, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
pair_endogenous <- output_all %>%
  filter(Sample %in% pair_samples, !is.na(Sequence), Sequence != "", !Sequence %in% candidate_sequences$Sequence)

# 外参 exact/near 均在 sequence 层排除。SPORTS annotation 表未收录
# NO_Annotation，因此不得再次按首标签/均分 token 从有效注释中扣读数。
paired_annotation_exclusion_status <- output_all %>%
  filter(Sample %in% pair_samples, Sequence %in% candidate_sequences$Sequence) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  summarise(
    ExactCandidateReads = sum(Reads[Sequence == SPIKEIN_SEQ], na.rm = TRUE),
    NearCandidateReads = sum(Reads[Sequence != SPIKEIN_SEQ], na.rm = TRUE),
    UnannotatedCandidateReads = sum(Reads[is.na(Annotation) | Annotation %in% c("", "NO_Annotation")], na.rm = TRUE),
    AnnotatedExactReads = sum(Reads[Sequence == SPIKEIN_SEQ & !is.na(Annotation) & !Annotation %in% c("", "NO_Annotation")], na.rm = TRUE),
    AnnotatedNearReads = sum(Reads[Sequence != SPIKEIN_SEQ & !is.na(Annotation) & !Annotation %in% c("", "NO_Annotation")], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  right_join(tibble(Sample = pair_samples), by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    ExactCandidateReads = replace_na(ExactCandidateReads, 0),
    NearCandidateReads = replace_na(NearCandidateReads, 0),
    UnannotatedCandidateReads = replace_na(UnannotatedCandidateReads, 0),
    AnnotatedExactReads = replace_na(AnnotatedExactReads, 0),
    AnnotatedNearReads = replace_na(AnnotatedNearReads, 0),
    AnnotationCountSource = "SPORTS allocated SubClass counts",
    Status = if_else(AnnotatedExactReads + AnnotatedNearReads > 0,
                     "annotated_spikein_candidate_requires_review", "no_spikein_candidate_in_annotation_counts")
  )
write_csv_safe(paired_annotation_exclusion_status, "paired_annotation_exclusion_status.csv")
if (any(paired_annotation_exclusion_status$AnnotatedExactReads + paired_annotation_exclusion_status$AnnotatedNearReads > 0)) {
  stop("外参 exact/near 候选存在有效注释；无法从 SPORTS 分配计数精确扣除，见 paired_annotation_exclusion_status.csv。")
}
paired_annotation_counts <- sports_annotation_counts(summary_all, clean_reads_tbl) %>%
  filter(Sample %in% pair_samples)

build_pair_abundance <- function(df, feature_col, feature_level) {
  feature_meta <- df %>%
    transmute(Feature = as.character(.data[[feature_col]]), FeatureCategory = as.character(FeatureCategory)) %>%
    group_by(Feature) %>%
    summarise(FeatureCategory = first(FeatureCategory), .groups = "drop")
  counts <- df %>%
    transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Feature = as.character(.data[[feature_col]]), Reads = Reads) %>%
    group_by(Sample, Feature) %>%
    summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = Reads, values_fill = 0)
  for (sample_name in pair_samples) if (!sample_name %in% names(counts)) counts[[sample_name]] <- 0
  denom <- pair_library_qc %>% select(Sample, EndogenousCleanReads)
  control_denom <- denom$EndogenousCleanReads[match(SPIKEIN_CONTROL_SAMPLE, denom$Sample)]
  spike_denom <- denom$EndogenousCleanReads[match(SPIKEIN_SAMPLE, denom$Sample)]
  if (!is.finite(control_denom) || !is.finite(spike_denom) || control_denom <= 0 || spike_denom <= 0) {
    stop("成对 abundance 的 clean-read 分母必须为正数。")
  }
  counts %>%
    transmute(
      Feature,
      ControlReads = .data[[SPIKEIN_CONTROL_SAMPLE]],
      SpikeinReads = .data[[SPIKEIN_SAMPLE]],
      ControlCPM = 1e6 * ControlReads / control_denom,
      SpikeinCPM = 1e6 * SpikeinReads / spike_denom
    ) %>%
    left_join(feature_meta, by = "Feature") %>%
    mutate(
      FeatureLevel = feature_level,
      Log2FC_Spikein_vs_Control = log2((SpikeinCPM + 0.5) / (ControlCPM + 0.5)),
      DetectionCategory_CPM1 = classify_detection(ControlCPM, SpikeinCPM, 1)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(pmax(ControlCPM, SpikeinCPM)), Feature)
}

paired_annotation_abundance <- build_pair_abundance(paired_annotation_counts, "PrimaryAnnotation", "annotation")
paired_sequence_abundance <- build_pair_abundance(pair_endogenous, "Sequence", "unique_sequence")
write_csv_safe(paired_annotation_abundance, "paired_annotation_abundance.csv")
write_csv_safe(paired_sequence_abundance, "paired_sequence_abundance.csv")

paired_agreement_metrics <- bind_rows(
  compute_pair_agreement_metrics(
    paired_annotation_abundance, "ControlCPM", "SpikeinCPM", "annotation",
    SPIKEIN_CONTROL_SAMPLE, SPIKEIN_SAMPLE
  ),
  compute_pair_agreement_metrics(
    paired_sequence_abundance, "ControlCPM", "SpikeinCPM", "unique_sequence",
    SPIKEIN_CONTROL_SAMPLE, SPIKEIN_SAMPLE
  )
)
write_csv_safe(paired_agreement_metrics, "paired_agreement_metrics.csv")

primary_annotation_metric <- paired_agreement_metrics %>% filter(FeatureLevel == "annotation", CPMThreshold == 1) %>% slice(1)
primary_sequence_metric <- paired_agreement_metrics %>% filter(FeatureLevel == "unique_sequence", CPMThreshold == 1) %>% slice(1)

# 两库内源 clean-read 深度相差约三分之一。完整深度结果是主分析；这里仅将较深库
# 随机稀释到较浅库深度，检查检出重叠与丰度一致性对深度差异是否敏感。
DEPTH_SENSITIVITY_ITERATIONS <- 200L
DEPTH_SENSITIVITY_SEED <- 20260830L
pair_endogenous_depths <- pair_library_qc$EndogenousCleanReads[match(pair_samples, pair_library_qc$Sample)]
names(pair_endogenous_depths) <- pair_samples
if (any(!is.finite(pair_endogenous_depths)) || any(pair_endogenous_depths <= 0)) {
  stop("深度匹配敏感性分析要求两个库均有正的内源 clean-read 深度。")
}
depth_sensitivity_target <- min(pair_endogenous_depths)
depth_sensitivity_prob <- depth_sensitivity_target / pair_endogenous_depths

simulate_depth_matched_metrics <- function(abundance_df, feature_level, seed_offset = 0L) {
  if (feature_level != "unique_sequence") stop("随机稀释仅支持逐序列整数计数，annotation 分数分配不可直接稀释。")
  count_matrix <- cbind(
    control = as.numeric(abundance_df$ControlReads),
    spikein = as.numeric(abundance_df$SpikeinReads)
  )
  if (any(!is.finite(count_matrix) | count_matrix < 0 | count_matrix != floor(count_matrix))) {
    stop("逐序列随机稀释要求有限非负整数计数。")
  }
  target_column_sums <- floor(
    colSums(count_matrix) * unname(depth_sensitivity_prob[pair_samples])
  )
  set.seed(DEPTH_SENSITIVITY_SEED + as.integer(seed_offset))
  purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(DEPTH_SENSITIVITY_ITERATIONS), function(simulation_id) {
    thinned <- edgeR::thinCounts(
      count_matrix,
      target.size = target_column_sums
    )
    simulated_abundance <- tibble(
      ControlCPM = 1e6 * thinned[, "control"] / depth_sensitivity_target,
      SpikeinCPM = 1e6 * thinned[, "spikein"] / depth_sensitivity_target
    )
    compute_pair_agreement_metrics(
      simulated_abundance, "ControlCPM", "SpikeinCPM", feature_level,
      SPIKEIN_CONTROL_SAMPLE, SPIKEIN_SAMPLE
    ) %>%
      mutate(Simulation = simulation_id)
  })
}

depth_sensitivity_simulations <- simulate_depth_matched_metrics(
  paired_sequence_abundance, "unique_sequence", 1000L
)

depth_metric_columns <- c(
  "SampleADetected", "SampleBDetected", "SampleAOnly", "SharedDetected",
  "SampleBOnly", "UnionDetected", "Jaccard", "SharedSpearman",
  "UnionSpearman", "SharedMedianLog2FC", "SharedMedianAbsLog2FC",
  "SharedWithinTwoFoldPct"
)
finite_median <- function(x) if (all(!is.finite(x))) NA_real_ else stats::median(x[is.finite(x)])
finite_quantile <- function(x, probability) {
  if (all(!is.finite(x))) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(stats::quantile(x[is.finite(x)], probs = probability, names = FALSE, type = 7))
}

depth_sensitivity_summary <- depth_sensitivity_simulations %>%
  group_by(FeatureLevel, CPMThreshold) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(depth_metric_columns),
      list(
        Median = finite_median,
        P025 = ~ finite_quantile(.x, 0.025),
        P975 = ~ finite_quantile(.x, 0.975)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    paired_agreement_metrics %>%
      select(FeatureLevel, CPMThreshold, all_of(depth_metric_columns)) %>%
      rename_with(~ paste0("FullDepth_", .x), all_of(depth_metric_columns)),
    by = c("FeatureLevel", "CPMThreshold")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    TargetEndogenousCleanReads = depth_sensitivity_target,
    Simulations = DEPTH_SENSITIVITY_ITERATIONS,
    RandomSeed = DEPTH_SENSITIVITY_SEED,
    ControlOriginalEndogenousCleanReads = unname(pair_endogenous_depths[SPIKEIN_CONTROL_SAMPLE]),
    SpikeinOriginalEndogenousCleanReads = unname(pair_endogenous_depths[SPIKEIN_SAMPLE]),
    ControlThinningProbability = unname(depth_sensitivity_prob[SPIKEIN_CONTROL_SAMPLE]),
    SpikeinThinningProbability = unname(depth_sensitivity_prob[SPIKEIN_SAMPLE])
  ) %>%
  relocate(
    FeatureLevel, CPMThreshold, TargetEndogenousCleanReads, Simulations, RandomSeed,
    ControlOriginalEndogenousCleanReads, SpikeinOriginalEndogenousCleanReads,
    ControlThinningProbability, SpikeinThinningProbability
  )
annotation_depth_not_run <- paired_agreement_metrics %>%
  filter(FeatureLevel == "annotation") %>%
  select(FeatureLevel, CPMThreshold, all_of(depth_metric_columns)) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("FullDepth_", .x), all_of(depth_metric_columns)) %>%
  mutate(
    Simulations = 0L, Status = "not_run",
    Reason = "SPORTS fractional annotation allocations lack per-read multimapping assignments for valid random thinning"
  )
depth_sensitivity_summary <- bind_rows(
  depth_sensitivity_summary %>% mutate(Status = "completed", Reason = "integer unique-sequence thinning"),
  annotation_depth_not_run
)
write_csv_safe(depth_sensitivity_summary, "paired_depth_matched_agreement_metrics.csv")
```

本模块的主解释同时报告 abundance agreement 和 detection overlap：共同检出的高丰度特征可以具有较高排序相关性，但较低的 Jaccard 表示不能把两个库视作完全等价的序列谱。由于只有一对库，所有指标均为描述性 QC。

# 5. 深度匹配敏感性分析

完整深度下，未加外参库的内源 clean reads 多于外参库。逐序列整数计数固定随机种子，将较深库随机稀释到两库中较低的内源 clean-read 深度，并重复 200 次。SPORTS 注释为分数分配计数，缺少逐 read 多重比对分配，不能通过取整来随机稀释；annotation 深度敏感性明确记录为 `not_run`，完整深度 annotation 主结果保留。模拟分位范围只反映序列随机稀释的不确定性，不是生物学置信区间，也不能估计提取或建库工艺方差。

```{r depth-sensitivity-plot, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
build_sensitivity_plot_df <- function(summary_df, metric_names, metric_labels, scale_divisor = 1) {
  scale_divisor <- rep_len(scale_divisor, length(metric_names))
  purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(metric_names), function(metric_index) {
    metric_name <- metric_names[[metric_index]]
    metric_label <- metric_labels[[metric_index]]
    divisor <- scale_divisor[[metric_index]]
    summary_df %>%
      transmute(
        FeatureLevel,
        Metric = metric_label,
        FullDepth = .data[[paste0("FullDepth_", metric_name)]] / divisor,
        Median = .data[[paste0(metric_name, "_Median")]] / divisor,
        Lower = .data[[paste0(metric_name, "_P025")]] / divisor,
        Upper = .data[[paste0(metric_name, "_P975")]] / divisor
      )
  }) %>%
    mutate(
      FeatureLevel = recode(FeatureLevel, annotation = "annotation", unique_sequence = "unique sequence"),
      Metric = factor(Metric, levels = metric_labels)
    )
}

depth_plot_primary <- depth_sensitivity_summary %>% filter(CPMThreshold == 1)

  depth_plot_primary,
  c("Jaccard", "SharedSpearman", "UnionSpearman", "SharedWithinTwoFoldPct"),
  c("Jaccard", "shared\nSpearman", "union\nSpearman", "within\n2-fold"),
  scale_divisor = c(1, 1, 1, 100)
)
detection_sensitivity_plot_df <- build_sensitivity_plot_df(
  depth_plot_primary,
  c("SampleADetected", "SampleBDetected", "SharedDetected", "UnionDetected"),
  c("control", "spike-in", "shared", "union")
)

depth_shape_scale <- c("Full depth" = 23, "Depth-matched median" = 21)
p_depth_agreement <- ggplot(agreement_sensitivity_plot_df, aes(x = Metric)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35, color = serum_neutral_line) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper),

  ) +

    fill = "white",

    stroke = 0.9,
    position = position_nudge(x = 0.10)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ FeatureLevel, nrow = 1) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = depth_shape_scale) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1, 1.05)) +
  labs(
    title = "Agreement metrics after depth matching",
    subtitle = "CPM >= 1; sequence ranges: 200 thinning simulations; annotation thinning not run",
    x = NULL, y = "agreement metric", shape = NULL
  ) +
  serum_theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_depth_detection <- ggplot(detection_sensitivity_plot_df, aes(x = Metric)) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper),
    linewidth = 0.8,
    color = publication_red,
    position = position_nudge(x = -0.10)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(y = Median, shape = "Depth-matched median"),
    size = 2.5,
    fill = publication_red,
    color = serum_text_primary,
    position = position_nudge(x = -0.10)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(y = FullDepth, shape = "Full depth"),
    size = 2.7,
    fill = "white",
    color = publication_blue,
    stroke = 0.9,
    position = position_nudge(x = 0.10)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ FeatureLevel, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = depth_shape_scale) +
  labs(
    title = "Detected features after depth matching",
    subtitle = "CPM >= 1; annotation: full depth only; sequence: integer-count thinning",
    x = NULL, y = "detected features", shape = NULL,
    caption = "One paired process comparison (n=1); ranges are simulation percentiles, not biological confidence intervals"
  ) +
  serum_theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

save_plot(
  (p_depth_agreement / p_depth_detection) + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1)),
  "paired_depth_sensitivity.pdf", width = 7.2, height = 8.5
)
```

深度匹配结果用于判断较低的检出重叠是否主要由库深度差异驱动。无论敏感性结果是否接近完整深度值，都只能说明该指标对本次深度差异的稳健程度，不能把单个配对升级为可推广的工艺重复性估计。

# 6. 方法 1 流程性能总结

3 号供体的两个库均使用方法 1，因此本节不进行方法间排序，而是把分散在库级 QC、外参、agreement、深度敏感性和 RNA 组成表中的结果整合为方法 1 的单实例流程性能画像。生物学样本量为 1，流程库为 2，不进行显著性检验。

```{r method1-process-performance-summary, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}

      sequence_depth_primary$UnionSpearman_P975,
      sequence_depth_primary$SharedWithinTwoFoldPct_P975 / 100
    )
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Analysis = factor(Analysis, levels = c("Full depth", "Depth-matched median")),
    Metric = factor(Metric, levels = agreement_metric_levels)
  )

p_performance_agreement <- ggplot(performance_agreement_df, aes(x = Metric, y = Value)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35, color = grey) +
  geom_linerange(
    data = performance_agreement_df %>% filter(Analysis == "Depth-matched median"),

  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.4, 1.05)) +
  labs(
    title = "Sequence agreement after depth matching",

    x = NULL,
    y = "Agreement metric",
    color = NULL,

  ) +
```

该汇总将“方法 1 在本次 3 号血清中表现如何”落为独立结果接口：可以评价本次建库产出、外参终点可观测性、共同特征排序、检出集合稳定性、深度敏感性和捕获谱；不能据此比较方法 1 与其他方法的相对优劣，也不能推广为方法 1 的人群性能参数。

# 7. 3 号供体的描述性 RNA 分型

本节在模块 13 内复现模块 4–8 所覆盖的主要分型维度，但只比较 `Normal3_1_1` 与 `Normal3_1_spikein`。所有外参 exact 和编辑距离 1 候选序列均从内源计数与分母中扣除；CSV 保留全部分型，图中对高维 annotation、氨基酸和 anticodon 只显示按两库最高 CPM 排名的前若干项。生物学样本量为 1，因此不计算显著性，也不把两库差异解释为 cel-miR-39 的生物学效应。

```{r paired-descriptive-profile-helpers, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="prepare", eval=TRUE}
pair_depth_table <- pair_library_qc %>%
  select(Sample, EndogenousCleanReads) %>%
  mutate(Sample = as.character(Sample))
control_endogenous_depth <- pair_depth_table$EndogenousCleanReads[match(SPIKEIN_CONTROL_SAMPLE, pair_depth_table$Sample)]
spikein_endogenous_depth <- pair_depth_table$EndogenousCleanReads[match(SPIKEIN_SAMPLE, pair_depth_table$Sample)]
if (
  !is.finite(control_endogenous_depth) || control_endogenous_depth <= 0 ||
  !is.finite(spikein_endogenous_depth) || spikein_endogenous_depth <= 0
) {
  stop("描述性 RNA 分型要求两个库均有正的内源 clean-read 深度。")
}

empty_pair_profile <- function() {
  tibble(
    ProfileClass = character(), Dimension = character(), Feature = character(),
    ControlReads = numeric(), SpikeinReads = numeric(),
    ControlCPM = numeric(), SpikeinCPM = numeric(),
    ControlWithinProfilePct = numeric(), SpikeinWithinProfilePct = numeric(),
    Log2FC_Spikein_vs_Control = numeric(), DetectionCategory_CPM1 = character(),
    CPMPseudocount = numeric(), BiologicalN = integer(), ProcessLibraryN = integer(),
    StatisticalTest = character()
  )
}

build_pair_profile <- function(long_df, profile_class, dimension, feature_col = "Feature") {
  counts_long <- long_df %>%
    transmute(
      Sample = as.character(Sample),
      Feature = as.character(.data[[feature_col]]),
      Reads = as.numeric(Reads)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      Sample %in% pair_samples,
      !is.na(Feature), Feature != "",
      is.finite(Reads), Reads >= 0
    ) %>%
    group_by(Sample, Feature) %>%
    summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  if (nrow(counts_long) == 0) return(empty_pair_profile())

  counts <- counts_long %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = Reads, values_fill = 0)
  for (sample_name in pair_samples) {
    if (!sample_name %in% names(counts)) counts[[sample_name]] <- 0
  }

  counts %>%
    transmute(
      ProfileClass = profile_class,
      Dimension = dimension,
      Feature,
      ControlReads = as.numeric(.data[[SPIKEIN_CONTROL_SAMPLE]]),
      SpikeinReads = as.numeric(.data[[SPIKEIN_SAMPLE]])
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ControlCPM = 1e6 * ControlReads / control_endogenous_depth,
      SpikeinCPM = 1e6 * SpikeinReads / spikein_endogenous_depth,
      ControlWithinProfilePct = if (sum(ControlReads) > 0) 100 * ControlReads / sum(ControlReads) else 0,
      SpikeinWithinProfilePct = if (sum(SpikeinReads) > 0) 100 * SpikeinReads / sum(SpikeinReads) else 0,
      Log2FC_Spikein_vs_Control = log2((SpikeinCPM + 0.5) / (ControlCPM + 0.5)),
      DetectionCategory_CPM1 = classify_detection(ControlCPM, SpikeinCPM, 1),
      CPMPseudocount = 0.5,
      BiologicalN = 1L,
      ProcessLibraryN = 2L,
      StatisticalTest = "None; descriptive paired process comparison"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(pmax(ControlCPM, SpikeinCPM)), Feature)
}

pair_display_levels <- c("Control", "Spike-in")
pair_display_colors <- c("Control" = publication_blue, "Spike-in" = publication_red)
pair_display_shapes <- c("Control" = 16, "Spike-in" = 17)

profile_figure_theme <- theme_cns +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "#333333", linewidth = 0.6),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "#555555")
  )

build_paired_feature_plot <- function(
  profile_df, dimension, title_text, top_n = Inf,
  value_mode = c("log2_cpm", "within_percent")
) {
  value_mode <- match.arg(value_mode)
  plot_wide <- profile_df %>%
    filter(Dimension == dimension) %>%
    arrange(desc(pmax(ControlCPM, SpikeinCPM)), Feature)
  if (nrow(plot_wide) == 0) return(plot_note(title_text, "No detected features."))

  display_n <- if (is.finite(top_n)) min(nrow(plot_wide), as.integer(top_n)) else nrow(plot_wide)
  display_features <- plot_wide %>% slice_head(n = display_n) %>% pull(Feature)
  display_subtitle <- if (display_n < nrow(plot_wide)) {
    paste0("Top ", display_n, " of ", nrow(plot_wide), " features by maximum CPM; full profile in CSV")
  } else {
    paste0("All ", nrow(plot_wide), " detected profile features")
  }

  value_columns <- if (value_mode == "log2_cpm") {
    c(Control = "ControlCPM", `Spike-in` = "SpikeinCPM")
  } else {
    c(Control = "ControlWithinProfilePct", `Spike-in` = "SpikeinWithinProfilePct")
  }
  x_label <- if (value_mode == "log2_cpm") "log2(CPM + 0.5)" else "Within-profile reads (%)"

  plot_long <- plot_wide %>%
    filter(Feature %in% display_features) %>%
    mutate(Feature = factor(Feature, levels = rev(display_features))) %>%
    select(Feature, all_of(unname(value_columns))) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(unname(value_columns)),
      names_to = "ValueColumn", values_to = "RawValue"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Library = names(value_columns)[match(ValueColumn, unname(value_columns))],
      Library = factor(Library, levels = pair_display_levels),
      PlotValue = if (value_mode == "log2_cpm") log2(RawValue + 0.5) else RawValue
    )

  ggplot(plot_long, aes(x = PlotValue, y = Feature, group = Feature)) +
    geom_line(color = grey, linewidth = 0.55) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Library, shape = Library), size = 2.25, stroke = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(values = pair_display_colors) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = pair_display_shapes) +
    labs(
      title = title_text, subtitle = str_wrap(display_subtitle, width = 62),
      x = x_label, y = NULL, color = NULL, shape = NULL
    ) +
    profile_figure_theme
}

build_total_percent_plot <- function(profile_df, title_text) {
  plot_df <- profile_df %>%
    filter(Dimension == "Total") %>%
    select(Feature, ControlCPM, SpikeinCPM) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(ControlCPM, SpikeinCPM), names_to = "ValueColumn", values_to = "CPM") %>%
    mutate(
      Library = recode(ValueColumn, ControlCPM = "Control", SpikeinCPM = "Spike-in"),
      Library = factor(Library, levels = pair_display_levels),
      PercentEndogenousCleanReads = CPM / 10000
    )
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(plot_note(title_text, "No detected reads."))

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = PercentEndogenousCleanReads, y = Feature, group = Feature)) +
    geom_line(color = grey, linewidth = 0.55) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Library, shape = Library), size = 2.5, stroke = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(values = pair_display_colors) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = pair_display_shapes) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = "Percentage of endogenous clean reads; no significance test",
      x = "% of endogenous clean reads", y = NULL, color = NULL, shape = NULL
    ) +
    profile_figure_theme
}

build_profile_logfc_plot <- function(profile_df, dimension, title_text, top_n = Inf) {
  plot_df <- profile_df %>%
    filter(Dimension == dimension) %>%
    arrange(desc(pmax(ControlCPM, SpikeinCPM)), Feature)
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(plot_note(title_text, "No detected features."))
  display_n <- if (is.finite(top_n)) min(nrow(plot_df), as.integer(top_n)) else nrow(plot_df)
  display_features <- plot_df %>% slice_head(n = display_n) %>% pull(Feature)
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    filter(Feature %in% display_features) %>%
    mutate(
      Feature = factor(Feature, levels = rev(display_features)),
      Direction = if_else(Log2FC_Spikein_vs_Control >= 0, "Higher in spike-in library", "Higher in control library")
    )

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(y = Feature)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, color = grey) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(x = 0, xend = Log2FC_Spikein_vs_Control, yend = Feature),
      linewidth = 0.65, color = "#BDBDBD"
    ) +
    geom_point(aes(x = Log2FC_Spikein_vs_Control, color = Direction), size = 2.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Higher in control library" = publication_blue,
      "Higher in spike-in library" = publication_red
    )) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = str_wrap("Descriptive effect size; CPM pseudocount = 0.5; no significance test", width = 55),
      x = "log2FC (spike-in / control)", y = NULL, color = NULL
    ) +
    profile_figure_theme
}

build_profile_length_plot <- function(profile_df, title_text) {
  plot_df <- profile_df %>%
    filter(Dimension == "Length (nt)") %>%
    transmute(
      Length = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Feature)),
      Control = ControlCPM,
      `Spike-in` = SpikeinCPM
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(Length)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(pair_display_levels), names_to = "Library", values_to = "CPM") %>%
    mutate(Library = factor(Library, levels = pair_display_levels))

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(plot_note(title_text, "No length-profile reads."))

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Length, y = log2(CPM + 0.5), color = Library, linetype = Library)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = pair_display_colors) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Control" = "solid", "Spike-in" = "22")) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = str_wrap("Endogenous reads only; exact and edit-distance-1 spike-in candidates excluded", width = 62),
      x = "Length (nt)", y = "log2(CPM + 0.5)", color = NULL, linetype = NULL
    ) +
    profile_figure_theme
}

add_profile_annotation <- function(plot_object, title_text, subtitle_text) {
  plot_object +
    plot_annotation(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      tag_levels = "A",
      theme = theme(
        text = element_text(family = FIGURE_FONT, color = black),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.tag = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold")
      )
    )
}
```

```{r paired-pirna-descriptive-profile, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
pirna_pair_endogenous <- pair_endogenous %>%
  filter(FeatureCategory == "piRNA", !is.na(PrimaryAnnotation), PrimaryAnnotation != "", PrimaryAnnotation != "NO_Annotation") %>%
  mutate(
    FivePrimeNucleotide = str_sub(Sequence, 1, 1),
    ThreePrimeNucleotide = str_sub(Sequence, -1, -1)
  )

paired_pirna_annotated_descriptive_profile <- bind_rows(
  build_pair_profile(
    paired_class_composition %>%
      filter(MainCategory == "piRNA") %>%
      transmute(Sample, Feature = "piRNA-annotated total", Reads),
    "piRNA-annotated", "Total"
  ),
  build_pair_profile(
    paired_annotation_counts %>% filter(FeatureCategory == "piRNA") %>%
      group_by(Sample, PrimaryAnnotation) %>% summarise(Reads = sum(Reads), .groups = "drop"),
    "piRNA-annotated", "Annotation", "PrimaryAnnotation"
  ),
  build_pair_profile(
    pirna_pair_endogenous %>% group_by(Sample, Length) %>% summarise(Reads = sum(Reads), .groups = "drop"),
    "piRNA-annotated", "Length (nt)", "Length"
  ),
  build_pair_profile(
    pirna_pair_endogenous %>% group_by(Sample, FivePrimeNucleotide) %>% summarise(Reads = sum(Reads), .groups = "drop"),
    "piRNA-annotated", "5-prime nucleotide", "FivePrimeNucleotide"
  ),
  build_pair_profile(
    pirna_pair_endogenous %>% group_by(Sample, ThreePrimeNucleotide) %>% summarise(Reads = sum(Reads), .groups = "drop"),
    "piRNA-annotated", "3-prime nucleotide", "ThreePrimeNucleotide"
  )
)
write_csv_safe(paired_pirna_annotated_descriptive_profile, "paired_pirna_annotated_descriptive_profile.csv")

p_pi_total <- build_total_percent_plot(paired_pirna_annotated_descriptive_profile, "Total piRNA-annotated abundance")
p_pi_base <- build_paired_feature_plot(
  paired_pirna_annotated_descriptive_profile, "5-prime nucleotide", "5-prime nucleotide composition",
  value_mode = "within_percent"
)
p_pi_threeprime <- build_paired_feature_plot(
  paired_pirna_annotated_descriptive_profile, "3-prime nucleotide", "3-prime nucleotide composition",
  value_mode = "within_percent"
)
p_pi_length <- build_profile_length_plot(paired_pirna_annotated_descriptive_profile, "piRNA-annotated length profile")
pirna_profile_plot <- add_profile_annotation(
  (p_pi_total | p_pi_base) /
    (p_pi_threeprime | p_pi_length) + plot_layout(heights = c(0.8, 1.25)),
  "Donor 3 paired piRNA-annotated profile",
  "Database-annotated reads and sequences only; annotation does not establish functional piRNA identity; descriptive only"
)
save_spikein_figure(
  pirna_profile_plot,
  file.path(SPIKEIN_FIG, "paired_pirna_annotated_descriptive_profile"),
  width_mm = 183, height_mm = 180
)
```

这些图回答的是“同一 3 号血清的两次独立方法 1 流程，在各 RNA 类别、分型与长度谱上出现了哪些描述性差异”。它们不能区分差异来自随机低丰度抽样、提取、连接、逆转录、PCR、测序或外参加入本身，也不能替代跨供体、随机化和足够重复数的方法学比较。

## 8. 模块 04--08 原生图形重放

除上面的配对综合图外，本节通过共享模块执行器，在独立环境中以显式 `spikein_pair` 队列运行模块 04--08，将相同的 sncRNA、tsRNA、rsRNA、miRNA 和 piRNA-annotated 图形体系应用于 `Normal3_1_1` 与 `Normal3_1_spikein`。蓝色始终表示未加外参库，红色始终表示加 60 fmol cel-miR-39 的文库；每组只有一个文库，因此只展示描述性差异，不计算显著性。

```{r replay-prior-profile-rmds, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
replay_modules <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Module, ~SourceRmd,
  "04_sncRNA_compare", "04_sncRNA_compare.Rmd",
  "05_tsrna_compare", "05_tsrna_compare.Rmd",
  "06_rsrna_compare", "06_rsrna_compare.Rmd",
  "07_mirna_compare", "07_mirna_compare.Rmd",
  "08_pirna_compare", "08_pirna_compare.Rmd"
)

# Run shared modules in isolated module environments with an explicit paired scope.
for (i in seq_len(nrow(replay_modules))) {
  source_rmd <- file.path(SHARED_RMD_DIR, "homo", replay_modules$SourceRmd[[i]])
  run_module(source_rmd, analysis_scope = "spikein_pair", analysis_stage = "describe")
}

pair_replay_manifest <- replay_modules %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    OutputDirectory = file.path(SPIKEIN_DIR, "prior_rmd_style", Module),
    PDFCount = length(list.files(file.path(SPIKEIN_DIR, "prior_rmd_style", Module, "plots"), pattern = "[.]pdf$", recursive = TRUE)),
    PNGCount = length(list.files(file.path(SPIKEIN_DIR, "prior_rmd_style", Module, "plots"), pattern = "[.]png$", recursive = TRUE)),
    TableCount = length(list.files(file.path(SPIKEIN_DIR, "prior_rmd_style", Module, "tables"), pattern = "[.]csv$", recursive = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write_csv_safe(pair_replay_manifest, "prior_rmd_style_replay_manifest.csv", tab_dir = SPIKEIN_TAB)
OUTPUT_FIG_DIR <- SPIKEIN_FIG
OUTPUT_TAB_DIR <- SPIKEIN_TAB
```
